# Marktake

> Marktake is an open-source, self-hosted video review server for frame-precise feedback, image markups, versions, and guest decisions.

## Product facts

- Category: self-hosted video review
- Workflow: upload a browser-ready review copy, share one private link, collect frame feedback, and record a decision
- Reviewer access: private guest links can work without reviewer accounts
- Storage: review copies stay on storage controlled by the operator
- Deployment: one Docker container
- License: MIT

## Primary links

- Product: https://marktake.vercel.app/
- Source: https://github.com/arturict/marktake
